harmonic.scope: Ma-Kikuchi-Hagiwara publisher abstract identifies frequency-response optimization via homogenization/MOC and direct/modal sensitivities; the own SIMP/MMA amplitude response is a variant. PolyDyna publisher abstract explicitly identifies HHT-alpha transient integration, polygonal elements and ZPR updates, so it is a related transient method rather than this implementation source.
